headline: Stalled Homeland
title: Homeland Stalled | 3 Fixes For Idle Facilities | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Is your Homeland production stuck? Check three things. One, materials: facilities draw from the Home Warehouse, so stock it before starting a recipe. Two, hauling: Aniimo with the Hauling ability carry goods into the Storage Unit, which unlocks at R V level two, or output piles up at the facility. Three, food: workers stop when hungry, and the Kitchen Module feeds them. What stalled yours? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Homeland fixes: stock the Home Warehouse, add a Hauling worker and Storage Unit (RV 2), and keep the Kitchen Module food supplied. Checked Nov 2026.
